method: Compare Cardiff's bibliographic abstract with the authors' journal-formatted manuscript abstract, analysis on page 21, Figure 11 on page 22, and the separate full-text 2026 Frontiers climate study. Preserve incompatible samples/metrics and explicitly prioritize the manuscript's substantiated finding over its contradictory metadata.

climate_sample.retrieval: March 2021 top 200 query results, with >=200 comments, >=90% English, consensus-aligned filters

comparison_gates: Comment-count shares and commenters are different units; prolific commenters are not the whole watching audience.
The political study's selected channels and 2020–23 comment collection are not the March 2021 search-ranked climate video sample.
Publisher bibliography metadata contradicts the journal-formatted full-text analysis; disclose both versions, do not silently choose the shorter record.
Classifier-derived relative toxicity differs in construct from manually supervised positive attitudes about climate messages.
Published 2025 and 2026 journal dates are not contemporary live 2026 comment samples.
No individual commenter handles, comments, political labels, protected traits or predictions are collected.
Neither study measures advertiser response, sponsor revenue, creator wages or population-wide opinion.
